# MSP Skills

> Free MCP servers and Skills that connect your MSP tools (PSA, RMM, backup, M365, and more) to the AI you already use - Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot, Codex, Cursor, and any agent that speaks the Model Context Protocol. Local SQLite mirror so cross-client questions don't hit API rate limits. Built for MSP business owners. No code required. Apache-2.0 licensed.

What this site calls an MCP server is what ChatGPT calls an app or connector, Claude on the web and Microsoft Copilot call a connector, and Claude Code calls a Skill - all the same MCP standard. Full answer: [What is an MCP server?](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/what-is-an-mcp-server.md)

Links ending in `.md` are clean Markdown copies; the HTML page is the same address with a trailing slash in place of `.md`. The other links are HTML pages with no Markdown copy (https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/, https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/skills/, https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/verified/), the full corpus (llms-full.txt), and Concierge, which links its folder on GitHub. Every Skill is also listed for agents at https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json

## Start here

- [Why msp-skills?](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/why.md): Why MSP owners install msp-skills instead of leaning on vendor-native AI: it answers questions the API can't, joins systems instead of reading one, holds one quality bar per connector, complements what your vendors ship, and is free, local, and yours.
- [What is an MCP server?](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/what-is-an-mcp-server.md): An MCP server is a small program that connects your AI to a real system like your PSA, safely, with your credentials, on your machine. Plain-language answer for MSP owners: what it is, how it differs from a chatbot integration, and what you can do with one.
- [Which AI agent? Install MSP Skills in any of them.](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/which-agent.md): Which AI tools speak MCP today and how to install MSP Skills connectors in each: Claude Desktop, Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex CLI, GitHub Copilot, Microsoft 365 Copilot, and Google Gemini. Pick your agent, follow the steps, mind the gotchas.
- [First-time setup - for MSP business owners new to all this](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/guides/first-time-setup.md): Beginner-friendly walkthrough for setting up MSP Skills if you've never used Claude Code, an MCP server, or a CLI. About 10 minutes start to finish.
- [Install a Claude Code Skill (also Codex CLI, any skill-capable agent)](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/install-skill.md): 
- [Install an MCP server (Claude Desktop, ChatGPT Desktop)](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/install-mcp.md): 
- [Build Sessions: connectors built live, every Thursday](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/build-sessions.md): Build Sessions are a free weekly working session where MSP connectors are built live against real systems. Bring your tenant and your hardest cross-client question, or just watch. Free to join, every Thursday, hosted by Compounding Teams.
- [How to contribute to MSP Skills](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/contributing.md): The four ways to contribute to MSP Skills, ordered by how much they help: send an it-works receipt from your real tenant, report a real-tenant bug, open a small fix or docs pull request, or add a whole connector. The full contributor guide lives in CONTRIBUTING.md at the repo root.
- [Credential leak contract](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/credential-leak-contract.md): The fixed rules every MSP Skills connector and its review are judged against: which values count as held credentials, what counts as a leak (a whole value at any length, pieces of 8 or more characters, credentials sent off their declared hosts), the closed list of encodings checked, public text, and the cases that are tracked but never block.
- [Is it safe to give an AI agent access to my PSA?](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/governance.md): How MSP Skills connectors keep your client data safe: read/write/destructive command tiers, server-side API scoping enforced by your own tenant, open source with no telemetry and no servers of ours, and gitleaks + DCO + claims gates in CI. For the security-native MSP owner.
- [The MSP AI Question Book](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/question-book.md): 779 plain-English questions your AI can answer from the PSA, RMM, backup, security, and billing tools you already run - aggregated from all 67 free MSP Skills connectors. No code required, runs locally.
- [Surviving a reprint: how connector fixes outlive cli-printing-press](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/reprint-survival.md): How MSP Skills keeps connector hand-fixes (live-API quirks, synthesized identifiers, bug-fix back-ports) alive when a connector is regenerated by cli-printing-press: spec encoding, a checked-in hand-fix ledger enforced in CI, and captured process lessons. The reprint-survival contract behind the Trust Center.
- [Request a connector, or tell us one worked](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/request-or-report.md): Two short web forms for MSPs who do not use GitHub: ask for an MSP Skills connector for a system you run, or send an it-works receipt after a connector worked against your live tenant. A person reads every submission before it becomes a public issue, and plain email works just as well.
- [How to request a new MSP Skill (90 seconds, no terminal)](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/requesting-a-skill.md): Don't see your PSA, RMM, backup, or M365 tool yet? Request a new MSP Skills connector in about 90 seconds - no code, no terminal, just a web form. The fastest way to move a system up the roadmap and get it co-built live in a free Build Session.

## Answers

- [Are MCP servers safe for MSP client data?](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/answers/are-mcp-servers-safe-for-msp-client-data.md): Whether MCP servers are safe for MSP client data depends on where they run. MSP Skills connectors run on your own machine with your own credentials, send nothing to servers of ours, tier every command read/write/destructive, and let your own tenant scope what the API key can reach. Plain-language answer for MSP owners.
- [How do MSPs use Claude and ChatGPT with their PSA?](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/answers/how-msps-use-claude-and-chatgpt-with-their-psa.md): How MSPs connect Claude, ChatGPT, Codex, and Copilot to their PSA, RMM, and backup tools: install a free MCP server connector that runs locally, then ask plain-English questions across every client. The AI runs the underlying command for you - triage, client cards, SLA breaches, cross-client analytics - no code required.
- [MCP server vs vendor built-in AI: which does what?](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/answers/mcp-server-vs-vendor-built-in-ai.md): An MCP server connector and your vendor's built-in AI solve different problems. Vendor AI is great inside one product - drafting a reply, summarizing one ticket. An MSP Skills MCP server is the cross-client, cross-system layer that joins your PSA, backup, and RMM and answers questions across your whole book of business. They complement each other; nothing gets ripped out.
- [MCP servers for MSPs in 2026: how the options compare](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/answers/mcp-servers-for-msps-2026.md): MSPs now have four kinds of MCP server to pick from: free open-source servers you run yourself, hosted gateways that hold your API keys and give your whole team one web address, Thread's server, built around its own service desk, and servers vendors build for their own products. The real choice is which AI app you use and who holds your keys.
- [What is a Claude Code Skill?](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/answers/what-is-a-claude-code-skill.md): A Claude Code Skill is a set of instructions and a tool that an AI agent reads to do a real job - like answering questions about your PSA. It's the same idea most AIs call an MCP server or connector. Plain-language answer for MSP owners, with how to install one and use it across your tools.

## Set it up in your AI agent

- [HaloPSA and Servosity in ChatGPT](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/integrations/chatgpt.md): Use HaloPSA and Servosity in ChatGPT via MCP Developer Mode. Step-by-step setup: run the MCP binary in HTTP mode, or bridge a stdio-only one with supergateway. Free MSP Skills, paid ChatGPT tier required (Plus/Pro/Team/Business/Enterprise/Education).

Cowork runs shell on your behalf - no terminal commands you type yourself, no JSON editing. For MSP business owners on Anthropic's GA desktop agent.
- [HaloPSA and Servosity in Google Gemini](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/integrations/gemini.md): Use HaloPSA and Servosity in Google Gemini via MCP. Gemini CLI is local and self-serve; the Gemini app is remote (HTTPS). Step-by-step for both. Free MSP Skills, runs on your machine.

- [HaloPSA and Servosity in Microsoft 365 Copilot / Copilot Studio](https://msp-skills.compoundingteams.com/integrations/microsoft-365-copilot.md): How to use HaloPSA and Servosity in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Studio via MCP. Honest guide: remote Streamable-HTTP only, needs hosting + a Copilot Studio license + tenant admin. Free MSP Skills.
